snippet.title: The World's Shortest Horror Game | Official Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
One button. One terrible idea.

The World's Shortest Horror Game is a deliberately tiny horror-comedy, coming to Steam on October 22, 2026.

Play it blind. Finish it in minutes. Pass it to a friend with almost no explanation.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5101180/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video_description&utm_campaign=wishlist_oct22_2026&utm_content=official_trailer

Headphones recommended. Details are not.
